jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary

Join athenahealth’s Clinicals division as a Product Manager responsible for a defined product area within the broader portfolio. In this role, you will understand customer needs and market opportunities, contribute to product vision, and define features that meet business and user requirements. You will also work closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to deliver safe, trustworthy, and valuable product experiences, including responsible use of AI in clinical workflows. This role reports to the Product leader for the assigned product area.

About The Team

The Mobile team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve the efficiency and experience of healthcare providers. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI-enabled solutions where they add value. The team collaborates closely to ensure products are usable, reliable, and aligned with clinical and business needs. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Define and manage the product strategy and roadmap for an assigned product area.
Work with engineering and scrum teams to prioritize backlog items and guide day-to-day delivery.
Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements that support successful implementation.
Partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate customer needs, market trends, and business opportunities.
Contribute to product discovery, including identifying problems, testing concepts, and validating solutions with users and stakeholders.
Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to shape AI-enabled features that are usable, measurable, and appropriate for clinical workflows.
Define how AI-enabled capabilities should behave, including expectations for trust, explainability, and human oversight where needed.
Monitor product performance after release and use feedback, data, and user input to guide improvements.
Support launch planning, adoption activities, and resolution of production issues as needed.
Use AI-enabled tools and product analytics to help refine requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and improve decision-making across product planning and delivery.

Additional Job Responsibilities

Support build-versus-buy evaluations for product capabilities.
Partner with product leadership on release decisions and stakeholder alignment.
Help manage alpha and beta feedback during product testing and rollout.
Represent the voice of the customer in product discussions and decision-making.
Coordinate with legal, compliance, sales, marketing, and operations partners when needed.
Contribute to measurement frameworks for product and feature performance.
Support continuous improvement efforts across the product lifecycle.

Expected Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related field is preferred.
5+ years of product management experience.
Experience working in an Agile environment preferred.
Experience in healthcare or health technology preferred.
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and how they apply to product delivery.
Familiarity with model lifecycle concepts such as training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
Familiarity with data pipelines, data quality considerations, and experimentation methods.
Understanding of responsible AI principles, including bias, explainability, and trust.
Experience working on AI-driven or data-intensive products preferred.
Experience bringing products to market and supporting adoption after launch.
Technical understanding of mobile, SaaS, data, and APIs to assess feasibility and timelines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture: Our talented employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal-opportunity

About Pebble:
Pebble is a fast-growing smart wearable and consumer tech brand focused on building products that blend technology, design, and everyday lifestyle. From smartwatches and audio devices to future wearable categories, we’re building products for a new generation of connected consumers.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help build and grow the Pebble fitness app ecosystem across smartwatches, smart rings, and future wearable products. This role involves working closely with app, firmware, design, QA, and growth teams to create fitness and companion app experiences people genuinely enjoy using every day.

What You’ll Do: 
Own and drive the roadmap for Pebble’s fitness and wearable companion apps
Improve experiences across activity tracking, sleep, heart rate, sports modes, notifications, syncing, watch faces, onboarding, and insights
Work with firmware and hardware teams to ensure smooth device integration
Translate user feedback, app reviews, and analytics into product improvements
Prioritize features, bug fixes, app performance, and release planning
Collaborate with design teams on clean, intuitive Android and iOS experiences
Coordinate testing and QA across multiple devices and OS versions
Explore AI-led features and experiences across fitness, health insights, personalization, and smart recommendations
Help shape future wearable categories and connected experiences

We’re Looking For Someone Who:
Has strong product sense and understands consumer user behavior
Can simplify complex user journeys and improve usabilityIs detail-oriented about UX, reliability, and product quality
Can work cross-functionally with developers, designers, firmware teams, and operationsUses data, user feedback, and experimentation to make product decisions
Has experience managing mobile app products
Understands current AI trends, tools, and how AI can improve consumer app experience

Bonus Points:
Experience with wearables, IoT, Bluetooth products, or fitness appsFamiliarity with Apple Health, Health Connect, or wearable APIsUnderstanding of retention, engagement, and habit-based productsExperience working on AI-powered features or personalization systemsStrong eye for product polish and everyday usability

Why This Role Matters
You won’t just manage an app. You’ll shape how users interact with Pebble devices every single day. Small details matter here — syncing reliability, onboarding flow, battery optimization, workout accuracy, and how seamless the overall experience feels over time.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building consumer products used daily at scale.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our global Digital Experience team, where innovation knows no borders. This team owns and scales whitelabel e-commerce and post-booking servicing products for leading global airline partners. It bridges complex backend capabilities with modern digital storefronts to deliver seamless traveler journeys. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will drive the strategy, evolution and operational excellence of our Digital Experience (DX) and Digital Experience Check-In (DXCI) products across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic platforms. You will guide technical execution, lead agile scrum backlogs and support global clients as they transition toward modern Offer & Order retailing. This role requires strong technical depth, cross-functional leadership and the ability to align global stakeholders to deliver high-impact enterprise software solutions.

What You'll Do

Drive product vision, strategy and detailed roadmaps for Digital Experience across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic initiatives.
Manage investment decisions, scoping and priority backlogs for scrum teams while writing user stories and defining acceptance criteria.
Collaborate closely with engineering teams to provide technical guidance, deliver scalable architectural solutions and maintain product quality.
Engage directly with global customer touchpoints, focus groups and industry events to gather market insights and shape product direction.
Lead product evolution as clients transition from legacy workflows toward modern Offer & Order retailing architectures.
Analyze and resolve technical escalations and maintenance issues alongside commercial and delivery teams to ensure operational stability.
Deliver product demonstrations for internal leadership and external global clients to showcase upcoming capabilities and enhancements.

What You'll Bring

Required qualifications

Minimum 5 years of experience in technical product management owning complex e-commerce platforms, enterprise SaaS or high-scale digital solutions.
Proven track record in market-facing roles, engaging directly with clients and partners to define requirements and influence product strategy.
Strong technical and data-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to bridge backend system architecture and front-end user experiences.
Success leading cross-functional execution and backlog refinement within agile software development environments.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to articulate complex technical concepts to senior stakeholders.
Strong organizational discipline with a history of managing multiple complex projects and competing priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience with airline reservation or travel management technology platforms and retailing trends.

TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of the DEX Monitoring and Automations area within TeamViewer ONE. This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the centre of TeamViewer's Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) strategy — the journey from reactive IT to fully autonomous endpoint operations.

You will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for two equally strategic pillars: proactive digital employee experience monitoring (real-time telemetry, DEX scoring, AI-driven insights) and IT workflow automation (the DEX Hub automation library, Tia Scripting, SCALE instructions, and remediation workflows). Working closely with Engineering, UX, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and GTM teams, you will define clear requirements, deliver iterative value, and create measurable outcomes for both IT administrators and the employees they support.

DEX Monitoring & Insights

Define and execute the product roadmap for real-time DEX telemetry, endpoint health monitoring, and experience scoring, evolving the DEX Score to reflect true user-centric performance during live usage.
Drive the development of AI-powered insights that transform raw telemetry into normalized, actionable intelligence — enabling IT teams to detect, investigate, and remediate issues before employees are impacted.
Own the Tia Reporting capability, enabling self-service conversational reporting and dynamic dashboards that replace static analytics with real-time, natural-language-driven insights.
Expand DEX visibility beyond the desktop by leading the strategy for DEX for Mobile (Android and iOS), Exoprise integration for network and SaaS performance monitoring, and future endpoint architecture investments.
Define and track key experience metrics (DEX Score, MTTR, proactive issue resolution rate) and use these to continuously improve platform effectiveness and customer outcomes.

Automations & Workflow Orchestration

Own the vision and roadmap for the TeamViewer DEX Hub automation library — the centralized, single source of truth for OOTB and custom SCALE instructions, automations, and remediation workflows across the organization.
Lead the strategy for Tia Scripting, enabling IT admins to create automations and scripts through natural language — lowering the barrier to automation creation and eliminating dependence on deep PowerShell or Bash expertise.
Define the end-to-end automation lifecycle: from discovery and creation to testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — ensuring automation is both powerful and safe for enterprise-scale operations.
Collaborate with Engineering and UX to design automation creation workflows that are accessible to IT generalists while remaining expressive enough for advanced users and MSPs.
Identify and prioritize automation use cases with the highest customer impact, grounded in field data, customer interviews, and win/loss analysis.

Cross-Functional & Strategic

Act as the product domain authority for DEX & Automations — representing roadmap priorities to senior stakeholders, customers, and field teams, and translating strategic goals into actionable, well-scoped requirements.
Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Sales to develop positioning, enablement materials, and go-to-market strategies that communicate the business value of DEX and automation capabilities to economic buyers (CIOs, DEX Program Owners).
Drive customer discovery through interviews, advisory councils, and field feedback loops — continuously synthesizing market signals into roadmap decisions.
Ensure that all roadmap items ladder to TeamViewer's AEM strategic narrative: the journey from reactive support to proactive, predictive, and ultimately autonomous endpoint management.

Requirements

Must Have

4+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably in endpoint management, ITSM, IT operations, or adjacent enterprise software.
Demonstrated experience owning complex, data-intensive product areas with strong analytical ability — comfort with telemetry, metrics-driven roadmapping, and outcome-based KPIs.
Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into well-defined product requirements and ship iterative value in an agile environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to influence without authority and align cross-functional stakeholders from Engineering to Executive leadership.
Experience working in or alongside GTM, Sales, or Customer Success functions, with the ability to create compelling product positioning and enablement content.

Nice to Have

Hands-on familiarity with DEX platforms (e.g. 1E, Nexthink, Riverbed Aternity) or IT automation tools (e.g. Ansible, PowerShell DSC, ServiceNow Orchestration).
Understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to IT operations — anomaly detection, predictive analytics, GenAI for scripting or remediation.
Experience in or exposure to the Gartner DEX Management Tools, UEM, or AEM market categories.
Scripting literacy in PowerShell, Bash, or Python — not a hard requirement, but enables faster domain depth and more productive engineering partnerships.
Fluency in German is a plus given the Munich location and regional customer base.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

Bonus: Ideally, you’ll also meet at least a few of the following requirements

BENEFITS AND PERKS:
At JioSaavn, we blur work and play, and you get all the perks of a global company. You will get to work with a dynamic group of entrepreneurs, who are delivering results and working zealously to make a difference in the way the world experiences music.

We are a $3B+ revenue company developing world-class software used by our businesses to deliver personalized products to more than 17 million customers globally. Our Mass Customization Platform (MCP) is a suite of modular, multi-tenant microservices enabling businesses to offer customized solutions at scale, combining the speed and efficiency of mass production with the uniqueness of personalization.

We are hiring an experienced Product Manager to join our Access Platform team at the Cimpress India Technology Centre. This team is responsible for Identity & Access Management (IAM), tenancy management, authentication, authorization, and fraud detection capabilities across all Cimpress businesses.
In this role, you will help define the product strategy, execute the roadmap, and deliver impactful features within the Access space. You will work closely with stakeholders from engineering, design, business, and security to identify requirements, shape solutions, and ensure effective delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with engineering, UX, and business stakeholders to define, build, and launch products that address customer needs in the IAM and Access domain.
Translate business needs into product requirements and user stories, maintaining a well-groomed and prioritized backlog.
Conduct customer and stakeholder interviews, analyze data, and monitor usage to guide decisions and validate outcomes.
Collaborate across teams to deliver product increments iteratively while balancing speed, quality, and risk.
Monitor product performance and usage metrics to identify areas for improvement and optimization.
Contribute to product vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with broader business goals.


Qualifications
4 to 8 years of experience in product management, preferably in a SaaS or technology-driven environment.
Strong understanding of product development principles and experience managing product life cycles end-to-end.
Proven ability to define and communicate product requirements clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with data-driven decision-making and an analytical mindset.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
Experience working in identity management, access control, or related domains is a plus.

What You'll Gain
An opportunity to grow by solving complex challenges in a scalable technology ecosystem.
A high-trust, high-autonomy environment that values innovation and ownership.
Work alongside a global team of talented product, engineering, and data professionals.
Flexible, remote-first work model with a people-first culture.


Why Join Cimpress?
At Cimpress, work isn’t just a location—it’s a place to grow. We provide opportunities to learn, take initiative, and lead change. We embrace experimentation and are always pushing boundaries to uncover what's possible. With a culture built on trust, empowerment, and collaboration, you’ll have the support you need to succeed.


We're Remote-First

Equal Opportunity Employer

About the Role
Innefu Labs is looking for a Product Manager who has personally taken an agentic AI product from a blank whiteboard to a production system — not someone who has only added AI features to an existing roadmap. You will own the vision, architecture-level tradeoffs, and go-to-market for a multi-agent, LLM-driven product line, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, applied AI, and design to ship autonomous systems that reason, plan, and act with minimal human handholding.
This is a builder's role. You are expected to be technically fluent enough to sit inside architecture discussions on agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation frameworks — and translate that into a roadmap, prioritization model, and business outcome the rest of the company can rally behind.
Location Delhi 
5 Days Work from office 
What You Will Own
Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an agentic AI product built from zero — problem discovery, architecture direction, MVP scoping, and scale-up.
Translate ambiguous, open-ended problems into a phased agentic system design: which tasks are agent-driven vs. deterministic, where human-in-the-loop checkpoints belong, and how autonomy expands release over release.
Partner with engineering on core architecture decisions — agent orchestration and planning layers, tool-calling/function-calling design, memory and state management, RAG and retrieval pipelines, and multi-agent coordination patterns.
Own the evaluation framework for agent quality — task success rate, hallucination/error rate, latency, cost-per-task, and safety guardrails — and use it to drive prioritization, not just measure it after the fact.
Define prompt, tool, and knowledge-source specifications working directly with applied AI/ML engineers; review agent behavior transcripts and failure cases as part of the regular product cycle.
Run structured discovery with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders to identify high-value workflows for autonomous or semi-autonomous automation.
Own the build-vs-buy and framework decisions in collaboration with engineering (agent frameworks, vector databases, LLM providers, orchestration layers) and stay current on the fast-moving agentic AI ecosystem.
Define and track north-star and input metrics for the product — adoption, task completion, time-saved, cost-to-serve — and report outcomes to leadership.
Own the end-to-end roadmap prioritization, sprint-level scoping with engineering, and release planning; write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for agent-based features.
Represent the product externally — customer demos, RFP/technical proposal support, and partner/analyst conversations — with the technical depth to answer architecture-level questions directly.
What You Bring
8–12 years in product management, with demonstrable ownership of at least one AI/ML or agentic AI product taken from concept/zero to a live, adopted release — not just a feature add-on to an existing product.
Working technical fluency in agentic AI system design: agent orchestration and planning (e.g., ReAct-style reasoning, task decomposition, multi-agent coordination), tool/function calling, and agent memory patterns.
Solid working knowledge of the surrounding AI stack: LLM APIs and fine-tuning/prompting tradeoffs, RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and evaluation/observability tooling for LLM-based systems.
Familiarity with common agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI-style orchestration, or equivalent in-house frameworks) and emerging standards such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool/agent interoperability.
Track record of writing clear PRDs/specs for ML-driven features, defining success metrics for probabilistic (not just deterministic) systems, and running structured experimentation.
Comfort partnering closely with engineering and applied AI/ML teams on architecture-level tradeoffs — you don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in a systems design conversation.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate deep technical tradeoffs into business language for leadership, sales, and customers, and vice versa.
Prior experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, security/intelligence, fintech, or another data-sensitive domain is a plus, given Innefu Labs' customer base.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; an MBA or equivalent is a plus but not a substitute for hands-on technical depth.
Nice to Have
Direct experience owning or contributing to a knowledge-graph or retrieval-heavy product (e.g., Neo4j, Qdrant/pgvector or similar vector stores).
Exposure to agent safety/guardrail design — RBAC for agent actions, audit logging, human-in-the-loop escalation design.
Past experience as an engineer, applied scientist, or technical founder before moving into product.

jobs.sourceTitle: Senior Product Manager, Data Commons Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
5 years of experience with direct focus on data pipelines, Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) infrastructure, or backend data systems.
Experience in data modeling, schema design, and API-first development.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience with Knowledge Graphs, ontologies, ontologies for statistics, semantic formats (JSON-LD), and entity resolution frameworks.
Experience managing vendor engagements, defining clear boundaries of ownership, and driving partner accountability.
Experience in data engineering concepts: ETL, Data Quality, Observability/Monitoring, DataProc, and database systems (BigQuery, Graph databases, SQL).

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

You will own product outcomes across our domain registration platforms. This is a multi-platform role: your decisions affect retail customers buying their first domain, resellers who build businesses on our APIs, and registry partners who hold us to hard compliance deadlines. You will take initiatives from discovery through delivery and adoption, and you will carry domain operations responsibility alongside product work.

You will join a small, product team where AI fluency is a first-class skill. We build with AI tools daily and expect you to do the same.

Own domain registration, renewal, transfer, and expiry journeys across retail and wholesale platforms, and drive platform consolidation and portfolio migration initiatives.
Translate registry and regulatory mandates (identity verification, KYC, data protection, country-code TLD policy) into product requirements and deliver them against immovable external deadlines.
Run domain operations: registry pricing changes, TLD launches and sunsets, registrar credential management, and coordination with registry partners.
Improve the platforms and APIs that thousands of resellers integrate with programmatically, writing requirements that hold up for partners, not just end customers.
Run structured voice-of-customer discovery with retail customers and reseller partners, turning support themes, churn signals, and partner feedback into a prioritized roadmap.
Partner with marketing on positioning, pricing, and go-to-market for new domain products such as protection, security, aftermarket, and premium domains.
Contribute to fraud prevention and abuse mitigation across purchase and account flows.
Build prototypes and simple working tools with AI coding agents to validate ideas and de-risk decisions before engineering investment.

You own two to three initiatives end to end, with requirements engineering trusts and stakeholders you keep aligned without escalation.
Voice-of-customer inputs from your discovery work visibly shape the domains roadmap.
Registry partners and internal teams treat you as the answerable owner for your platforms.

Must Have

4 to 7 years of product management experience on platforms, marketplaces, APIs, or transactional products.
AI fluency as a daily working practice: you use AI agents and coding tools such as Claude Code to research, analyze, and build, not just to draft text.
Ability to code: you can build prototypes and simple working applications yourself to test ideas, demo flows, and answer questions before committing engineering time.

Strong written requirements; engineering teams across time zones will build from your documents.
Proven ability to run multiple concurrent initiatives with different stakeholders and deadlines without dropping threads.
Comfort with compliance-driven work: legal and policy constraints, and decisions made with incomplete data where risks are explicit.

Domain industry, hosting, or registrar/registry experience.
Experience with B2B2C or channel/reseller business models.
Exposure to payments, fraud, or identity verification products.

Real ownership of a global portfolio at meaningful scale, direct exposure to registries and international partners, and a team that treats product craft and AI fluency as career accelerants.

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

AI Innovation and Research Accelerator (AIRX) is a part of AIR, a standalone team within Platforms and Devices (P&D), that is known for building cutting-edge AI product experiences and getting them to billions of users.

You will build the next generation of user experiences across P&D by building on frontier AI model and partnering directly with Google Play Product and Engineering teams to turn green-field research into shipped impact for developers and users.

Build products and define the path from zero-to-one. 
Build bridges between exceptional research and product execution by fostering consensus and collaboration.
See your work move from research to shipped products quickly.
Outsize impact by operating across various product areas, influencing how billions of users experience AI across the ecosystem.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

Bridge Frontier AI Research and Product Execution: Serve as the core liaison between AIR, Google DeepMind, and Google Play leadership to translate cutting-edge foundation models and agentic workflows into production-ready features.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Principal Product Manager, APAC Payments Scheme Integrations

Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. We need someone to help us move money seamlessly in APAC.

We process hundreds of millions of payments for our customers per year. When Wise started we used banks to power our payments. But as we’ve grown we’ve started connecting directly to national payment schemes such as Australia’s NPP, Singapore’s FAST, Philippines' InstaPay, and Japan’s Zengin.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead our efforts in integrating and optimising national payment scheme integrations across the APAC region. This role will focus on expanding Wise’s reach through new payment scheme integrations while continuously improving the performance of existing scheme integrations.

What You’ll Do

Understand customer needs: Build an understanding of how payment schemes impact our customers, and use this understanding to drive product decisions. 
Determine the strategy for Wise’s payment scheme integrations: Work with internal teams, regulators, and payment scheme operators in order to build a multi-year roadmap of which payment scheme functionality Wise should be connected to. Lobby for changes to payment schemes to make our customers' lives better.
Lead payment scheme integrations: Alongside engineering leads, you’ll be managing technical integrations with payment schemes. This will include working with multiple internal stakeholders, ensuring strong project management is in place, identifying risks and opportunities early and adapting to them.
Monitor and optimise: Use data to track the performance of integrations and drive continuous improvement.
Drive operational excellence: Identify and implement improvements to enhance the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of the scheme integration.

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring

Significant product management experience in payments, ideally in finance/fintech.
8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles. 
For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role
A knack for project management: This is not a project manager role, but payment scheme integrations have many moving parts and you will be accountable for the team’s success.
Analytical mindset: Ability to use data to make informed decisions and track performance metrics.
Customer focus: A passion for building products that solve real customer problems.
A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.
Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,
Nice to Have

Experience working with payment scheme integrations
Experience in fintech or a high-growth tech company.
The ability to write SQL
Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About Refold AI 

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

What you'll do:

Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

What we're looking for:

You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

Our 1,200+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com

Job Title: Product Manager

Location: Hyderabad, India

Reports To: Director of Product Management, JAI

Type: Full-Time

About The Role

This role owns JAGGAER's analytics and data products: the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the next generation of data products we build for customers. These are established, revenue-generating capabilities with live commitments across the customer base, and they are being reshaped by AI faster than any other part of the platform.

The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.

You will work across the JAI portfolio, because the data and intelligence layer you own is what every agent and research capability in the product reasons over.

This is a strategy and delivery role in a single seat. You will set the direction, and you will be measured on what ships against it.

Principal Responsibilities

Product ownership: Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the data products built on them. 
AI-native insight capabilities: Define and deliver new AI capabilities in this space, including generated insight and anomaly detection across customer spend, taking them from concept through early access to general availability. 
Product direction: Define what analytics and data products become as AI absorbs them, including how customers consume data when their own systems and agents are the consumer rather than a person, and where the boundary sits between surfacing an insight and acting on it. Establish the product direction for agent-ready data delivery. 
Data trust and accuracy: Own the quality bar for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over: the definitions of core procurement measures, the evaluation approach that proves accuracy, and the standard a model must meet before it is used with a customer. 
Committed delivery: Meet the existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments already sold to customers, including those carried in active RFPs and renewals, and keep the install base on a clear roadmap. 
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with engineering, applied AI, UX, and the Experience, AgentOS and Deep Research product managers, so the data and intelligence layer serves the whole JAI portfolio rather than one surface. 
Market and customer insight: Validate problems and proposed capabilities directly with customers and prospects, and use that evidence to prioritise. Support analytics and data content in RFPs and executive briefings. 
Agile execution: Translate product requirements into clear, well-defined requirements and acceptance criteria for the engineering teams, and work with them through delivery. 
Metrics and performance: Define and report the KPIs for this scope, including adoption of the AI insight surfaces, accuracy against the evaluation set, and delivery against customer commitments. 

Position Requirements

What You Will Bring 

3+ years of product management experience in SaaS or enterprise software, including ownership of a product area end to end. 
Hands-on experience with AI products, including LLM-powered applications, prompt engineering, retrieval architectures, or applying AI to structured enterprise data. 
Strong working understanding of data platforms, semantic and dimensional modelling, and analytics or BI tooling. Snowflake experience is an advantage. 
A rigorous approach to accuracy: comfort defining ground truth, designing evaluation sets, and holding a quality bar under delivery pressure. 
Experience working with enterprise customers to validate problems and quantify value, rather than gathering feature requests. 
Experience with procurement, source-to-pay, supply chain or finance data is an advantage. 
Proficiency in Agile methodologies and working closely with distributed engineering teams. 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. 

Success in This Position 

An outcome focus, with customer value always in mind. 
Comfortable saying no to a capability that has not met the accuracy bar, and able to explain that decision commercially to sales and to customers. 
Able to hold both a multi-year product direction and a current-quarter delivery commitment without losing either. 
Strong written and verbal communication in English, and credible with both engineering and business leadership. 
Effective at influencing without authority across product, engineering and go-to-market teams. 
Accustomed to working in an international environment across multiple development sites and time zones. 

Goals for the First 12 Months 

An agreed product direction for analytics and data products in an AI-first platform, signed off with Product and Engineering leadership and reflected in the roadmap. 
Generated insight and anomaly detection delivered to early access customers, with adoption and accuracy reported as the primary measures of success. 
A published quality and evaluation standard for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over, with accuracy tracked and reported. 
All existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments met, with a clear and communicated roadmap for the install base. 
Customer validation of the new AI capabilities in this space, with quantified outcomes suitable for use in renewals and new business. 

What We Offer

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.

Our Values - T.E.A.M

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.

Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners. 
Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth 
Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere 
Metrics-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

Job Summary
As a Product Manager for Search & Conversational Discovery, you will work at the intersection of product, data, engineering, design, and AI/ML to build experiences that help millions of users discover and engage with content. You will own well-defined product problem areas across Search and Conversational Voice Discovery (CVD), from identifying user and business opportunities to defining solutions, running experiments, and measuring impact.

You will use data, user insights, experimentation, and structured problem-solving to improve how users find, discover, and interact with content. This is an opportunity to work on highly visible consumer experiences across JioHotstar's 500M+ user base while developing deep expertise in Search, conversational experiences, and AI/ML-powered product development.
About the Team
At JioHotstar, we're on a mission to deliver delightful experiences to our 500+ million customers across the globe. Our technology spans 25+ countries, with more on the horizon. The Search team sits within the Viewer Experience org and is responsible for helping every user find exactly what they're looking for through text search.
We blend world-class engineering, ML/NLP, design, and data to deliver a fast, relevant text search experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building intelligent search and query-understanding systems that measurably improve how hundreds of millions of users discover content, join us in shaping the future of entertainment discovery.
Key Responsibilities
Own specific product problem areas across Search and/or CVD, taking them from problem discovery and definition through execution, launch, experimentation and measurement.
Analyze user behavior, search/query data, product funnels, and key metrics to identify gaps and opportunities that can improve content discovery and engagement.
Translate user and business problems into clear product requirements, hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable product roadmaps.
Partner closely with Engineering, ML/Data Science, Design, and other stakeholders to prioritize, build, test, and launch product improvements.
Work on areas such as search relevance, query understanding, suggestions, content discovery, conversational flows, voice interactions, and AI-powered discovery experiences, depending on the problem area.
Design and evaluate A/B experiments, interpret results, and use learnings to continuously improve the product.
Develop an understanding of how ML/AI systems work in production, including model inputs, outputs, evaluation metrics, limitations, and their implications for product decisions.
Monitor product performance after launch and take ownership of key KPIs and quality metrics for the areas you own.
Work with the broader Search/CVD team to understand dependencies and ensure that improvements are consistent with the overall product strategy.
Benchmark competitor experiences, conduct user research where relevant, and bring external insights into product decisions.
Respond quickly to changing user needs, content launches, live events, and other business priorities that impact discovery and conversational experiences.
Communicate product decisions clearly through PRDs, product reviews, GTM documents, data analysis, and stakeholder discussions.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong product thinking: Ability to break ambiguous problems into structured, solvable problems and identify the highest-impact opportunities.
Data-driven mindset: Comfortable working with product metrics, funnels, query/user data, experiments, and using data to make decisions.
Strong execution: Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams and consistently take products/features from idea to launch.
Customer empathy: Ability to understand user pain points and translate them into meaningful product improvements.
Analytical thinking: Ability to form hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, interpret experiment results, and make clear recommendations.
AI/ML curiosity: Working understanding of AI/ML concepts and a strong interest in applying them to consumer products. Familiarity with LLMs, NLP, recommendation/search systems, or conversational AI is a plus.
Clear communication: Ability to articulate problems, product decisions, trade-offs, and requirements with clarity and structure.
Ownership: Takes responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks; proactively identifies issues and drives them to resolution.
Collaboration: Comfortable working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, ML, and other teams.
Learning agility: Able to quickly build domain expertise in complex areas such as Search, relevance, conversational AI, and content discovery.
Preferred Education and Experience
Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent with minimum 2+ years of experience in product management preferably building consumer-facing digital products.
Experience owning products/features end-to-end, from problem definition to launch and post-launch measurement.
Strong experience with data-driven product development and experimentation.
Exposure to Search, Recommendations, AI/ML, NLP, GenAI, conversational products, voice interfaces, or content discovery is preferred.
Experience working with engineering and/or ML teams on technically complex products is a plus.
Demonstrated track record of measurable product impact, rather than only feature delivery.
About JioStar
Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.
JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. Company overview:

TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.

Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.

Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.

Position Overview

The OPUS Platform Knowledge Expert is a platform and subject-matter expert responsible for developing, structuring, and maintaining the messaging, positioning, and core knowledge artifacts that power TraceLink’s OPUS Platform go-to-market execution, field enablement, and AI-driven experiences for both customer personas and TraceLink field teams.

The OPUS Platform Knowledge Expert serves as the global owner of the OPUS platform capability areas—such as Opus Reports and Dashboards, Opus Solution Environment, Solution Catalog, user administration, metadata management, etc.—and builds the messaging frameworks, insights, and artifacts that support executive-level conversations across all relevant customer segments.

This is a unique role combining platform expertise, industry context, strategic storytelling, and knowledge artifact creation, and curation for executive buyer experiences.

Responsibilities

OPUS Platform Domain Expertise

Serve as TraceLink’s subject-matter expert for the OPUS Platform, supporting Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, Sales Enablement, and Sales teams. 
Build a deep understanding of OPUS Platform architecture and capabilities, and how the platform enables TraceLink solutions and customer business outcomes. 
Translate complex platform concepts into clear business value for executive, technical, and operational personas. 
Participate in select cross-functional initiatives, roadmap discussions, and executive or customer engagements as required. 

Strategic Narratives, Messaging, and Positioning

Develop strategic narratives, messaging, and positioning for the OPUS Platform targeting executive and technical decision-makers (e.g., CIO, CDO, CTO, Enterprise Architects). 
Articulate the OPUS Platform value proposition as the foundation for TraceLink solutions, ecosystem participation, and digital network effects. 
Create and maintain competitive differentiation against alternative platforms, point solutions, and legacy integration approaches. 
Continuously validate and refine messaging through regular engagement with field teams, customers, and prospects. 

AI and LLM Buying & Enablement Experiences

Build and maintain an LLM-ready OPUS Platform messaging framework with modular, metadata-tagged positioning, capabilities, and value narratives. 
Ensure taxonomy alignment, version control, and canonical terminology so platform messaging is consistent, current, and consumable by AI systems. 
Curate and govern the OPUS Platform knowledge corpus to ensure accurate, secure, and authoritative AI-generated outputs. 
Design executive- and architect-ready LLM experiences using prompt patterns, scenarios, and platform value-story templates for internal enablement and external buyer interactions. 

Deliverables and Key Knowledge Artifacts

Create and maintain a standard set of OPUS Platform knowledge artifacts that drive executive conversations, field enablement, and LLM-driven experiences, including but not limited to:

OPUS Platform Messaging & Positioning Playbook documenting platform vision, value pillars, persona-based messaging, and competitive differentiation. 
LLM-Ready Platform Messaging Framework & Metadata Schema defining modular platform message objects, taxonomies, and canonical terminology for AI ingestion. 
Curated OPUS Platform Knowledge Library, including architecture overviews, capability descriptions, platform services, extensibility patterns, security and compliance models, and glossary of terms. 
Executive Platform Narrative Decks tailored for CIO, CTO, CDO, and VP-level personas, highlighting business value, scalability, interoperability, and long-term platform ROI. 
Competitive Platform Landscape & Differentiation Dossiers comparing OPUS to alternative platforms, middleware, and integration strategies with scenario-based differentiation and objection handling. 
LLM Prompt Patterns, Conversation Flows, and Experience Blueprints enabling consistent, high-credibility AI-driven conversations about the OPUS Platform. 
Field Enablement Knowledge Packs including platform talk tracks, architecture narratives, use-case mappings, objection handling, and LLM-powered microlearning assets. 

Skills And Qualifications

10 + years of experience in product management, product marketing, platform strategy, solution consulting, or analyst roles with exposure to enterprise platforms, data networks, or SaaS ecosystems. 
Strong understanding of platform concepts such as APIs, data models, interoperability, extensibility, security, and scalability. 
Exceptional writing and presentation skills, particularly for senior executive and technical audiences. 
Ability to distill complex, technical platform capabilities into clear, structured business narratives. 
Experience producing strategic content such as platform briefs, architecture narratives, whitepapers, or competitive analyses. 
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), conversational AI, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. 
Experience in structuring, tagging, and governing content for AI/ML consumption is a plus. 
Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Solution Consulting, Value Engineering, and Services teams. 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience required. 
Travel: Ability to travel up to 25% as required by business needs.

About The Role

HighLevel’s Commerce platform is the system of record for how our customers sell — what they offer and how it is priced, how orders get fulfilled, and how money moves: payments in, invoices out, and books that balance . It spans product information, pricing, taxes, and channels; fulfillment and inventory; and the full finance stack of payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger — together powering commerce for a global base of agencies and businesses operating at scale.

We are seeking a Group Product Manager, Commerce , to lead product across three connected verticals — Business Operations, Fulfillment Operations, and Finance — and the team of Product Managers who own them. You will set the strategy for the end-to-end commerce lifecycle, from catalog to cash , and be accountable for the coherence, reliability, and growth of the platform as a whole.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who has managed and grown other Product Managers , and who can zoom from platform strategy down to the details of a pricing engine, a fulfillment flow, or a ledger entry. You lead through your team, raise the bar on product craft , and turn a broad, interdependent surface area into a clear, sequenced roadmap.

Your mission: To build a coherent, reliable, and extensible commerce platform — spanning what customers sell, how it is fulfilled, and how they get paid — and to build the team that delivers it, so HighLevel’s customers can run their entire business on us.

What You’ll Do

Set Commerce Product Strategy – Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap across Business Operations, Fulfillment, and Finance , translating a broad, interdependent surface area into clear, sequenced priorities.

Lead & Grow a Team of PMs – Manage, mentor, and hire Product Managers across the verticals, setting a high bar for product craft and owning their performance, development, and career growth .

Own the End-to-End Commerce Lifecycle – Be accountable for the full catalog-to-cash journey — product information and pricing, fulfillment and inventory, payments, invoicing, and ledger — as one connected system.

Drive Platform Coherence – Ensure shared contracts like the analytics engine, layouts, and reporting are designed once and reused, so the verticals compose into a single, consistent platform rather than a set of silos.

Deliver Business Operations – Guide the PIM, pricing, taxes, channel configuration, loyalty, and analytics roadmap that lets merchants define what they sell, to whom, and at what price.

Deliver Fulfillment Operations – Steer fulfillment, inventory, and the upcoming warehousing, time-clocking, and metering charters so what was sold reliably reaches the buyer.

Deliver Finance – Own the payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger/accounting roadmap, ensuring money moves securely and the books balance across providers and external systems like QuickBooks and Xero.

Own Outcomes & Metrics – Drive measurable growth in GMV, transaction success, merchant adoption, and reliability , using data to prioritize across a large and competing set of bets.

Partner with Senior Stakeholders – Work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and leadership to align on strategy, resourcing, and trade-offs, and represent Commerce in company-level planning.

Balance Delivery & Long-Term Bets – Keep near-term charters shipping on time while investing in the platform foundations that compound over the next several years .

Raise the Operating Bar – Establish the rituals, specs, and quality standards — discovery, prioritization, launch, and review — that make the team predictable, fast, and outcome-driven .

Who You Are

Experienced People Leader – You have managed and grown Product Managers, and you get energy from multiplying your impact through a strong, well-run team .

Platform & Commerce Depth – You have led product across commerce, payments, fintech, or a comparable transaction-heavy platform , and understand how catalog, fulfillment, and finance fit together.

Strategic and Execution-Focused – You can define a multi-vertical strategy and still hold your teams to crisp execution , ensuring ideas translate into shipped, measurable impact.

Systems Thinker – You see the interdependencies across modules and design for coherence, reuse, and shared contracts rather than one-off solutions.

Outcome- & Customer-Centric – You balance business goals, risk, and trust, keeping the merchants who run their business on the platform at the center of every decision.

Highly Data-Driven in Ambiguity – You are comfortable prioritizing across a broad, messy portfolio, using data to make sharp trade-offs without waiting for perfect information.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of Product Management experience , including 2+ years directly managing Product Managers , and 10+ years of total professional experience. 
A track record of leading product across a large, multi-team surface area — ideally in commerce, payments, fintech, or platform/SaaS — with measurable business impact. 
Proven people leadership : hiring, developing, and retaining strong PMs, and building the operating rhythm of a high-performing product team. 
Strong platform and systems judgment , with the ability to reason about how pricing, fulfillment, payments, invoicing, and ledger interconnect . 
Experience partnering with senior engineering, design, and business stakeholders to set strategy, secure resourcing, and drive company-level outcomes. 

Bonus: 

You have owned a commerce or payments platform end-to-end — from catalog to cash — at significant scale , and can clearly articulate your impact on growth, reliability, and team development. 

Why should you join us? 

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. Job Description

This is a remote position.

Experience Level

We're looking for a seasoned Product Owner with at least 2–4 years of experience owning a product backlog end-to-end within an Agile delivery environment. You should be a "delivery craftsperson" who can demonstrate a track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team requirements into shipped, working software — with particular comfort operating inside platforms where your product's success depends on coordination with teams you don't manage.

Role Overview

As a Product Owner, you will own the backlog and delivery cadence for one product within a tightly interconnected platform, where your product's roadmap depends on — and feeds into — several sibling products. You'll act as the point of alignment between engineering teams, supporting product managers, and client stakeholders, translating business and compliance needs into backlog items ready for a development team to execute against.

A key part of the role is holding the line on requirements quality: defining clear acceptance criteria before work enters a sprint, and sequencing competing demands — new features, maintenance of live services, and production support — that your team carries simultaneously. Because your product does not operate in isolation, a large part of the job is coordinating dependencies across teams that don't report to you.

Key Responsibilities

Backlog Ownership & Requirements Definition: Own and prioritize the product backlog; define acceptance criteria for accuracy, completeness, and readiness before stories are marked sprint-ready.
Cross-Team Dependency Coordination: Sequence and negotiate delivery across multiple dependent engineering teams (platform, integration, infrastructure, and adjacent product teams), since most features require multi-team scheduling rather than single-team execution.
Delivery Prioritization Under Competing Demands: Balance new feature development, maintenance of live production services, and active production support within the same backlog, without letting one silently starve the others.
Domain Ramp-Up: Build working depth in the specific technical and regulatory domain tied to your assigned product — this may include healthcare EDI transaction standards, web-automation/data-extraction reliability, credential and access-security models, or regulated payments and remittance processing, depending on placement.
Stakeholder & Requirements Governance: Partner with the supporting Product Manager and client-side stakeholders to close open requirement decisions before development starts, hold sign-off discipline, and manage rework risk from late-stage scope changes.
Data & Interface Quality Ownership: Where your product's output feeds downstream systems, own the interface contract (field definitions, data completeness, naming) to prevent avoidable rework further down the chain.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Proven Product Ownership Experience: Track record owning a backlog end-to-end in an Agile environment, ideally within a platform where products are tightly coupled rather than independent.
Domain Adaptability: Comfort ramping quickly into unfamiliar technical or regulatory domains — some assignments require near-immediate fluency (e.g., regulated payments, EDI standards), while others allow for a longer runway.
Cross-Functional Coordination Skills: Demonstrated ability to sequence work and resolve competing priorities across multiple engineering teams that don't report into the same chain.
Analytical Rigor: Ability to write precise, testable acceptance criteria and reason through data quality or completeness gaps before they become delivery blockers.
Strong Stakeholder Communication: Comfortable representing product status and trade-offs to both engineering teams and client-facing stakeholders, in plain, non-technical language when needed.
Judgment Under Ambiguity: Able to recognize when a decision needs escalation versus independent ownership — particularly important for the more regulation-heavy assignments, where working without senior support isn't advisable early on.

Why this role, why now?
Neysa is building the AI cloud for the era where AI runs in production rather than in pilots. The promise we are claiming to deliver is operational confidence, the ability for an enterprise to run AI predictably, affordably and accountably. Infrastructure choices now decide which AI programmes are viable at all, and for us sovereignty means strategic control rather than a compliance checkbox.
Velocis is how we deliver that, across GPU as a service and our AI platform as a service. We are scaling from strong early proof into a platform that serves sovereign enterprise buyers in India and large offtake capacity globally. This role exists to help set product direction and to make it real.

The Role
We are hiring a Senior Director of Product to sit alongside the Chief Product Officer as a balanced strategist and operator, and to co-own the Velocis product ecosystem. You will help shape the two-year product strategy and you will own the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off that turn it into shipped platform. Engineering, infrastructure operations, design and go-to-market are your delivery partners, and product holds the pen on what gets built and in what order.
You will move between whiteboarding high-density cluster architecture with an executive buyer in one hour and running a deep specification review with a product manager in the next. Both are the job.

What you will own?Product strategy and roadmap
• Co-own the 12 and 24 month strategy for Velocis across GPU as a service and the AI platform, and hold the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off end to end.
• Ship the Velocis AI platform stack and move straight into post-launch feature velocity, reliability, and the Day-0 and Day-1 user journey.
• Keep a live read on the global AI infrastructure landscape, across orchestration layers, sovereign cloud, inference economics and power and density, so Velocis holds its edge.

Team and craft

• Build a product culture of extreme ownership, technical precision and fast feedback, and raise the hiring bar as the team grows.

Enterprise commercials and offtake
• Partner with the CPO and CEO on offtake opportunities from 1,000 to 8,000 GPUs, shaping orchestration specs, tenant isolation and SLA commitments.
• Act as executive product sponsor for key Indian enterprise accounts.
• Turn bespoke offtake and enterprise requirements into platform capabilities the wider base can use, without fragmenting the core codebase. This is one of the hardest and most important parts of the role.
Platform economics
• Own core product economics with the CPO, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin, tenant density and feature monetisation.
• Treat onboarding time to value and expansion as first-order outcomes, since Velocis revenue behaves as consumption rather than subscription and expansion is the dominant growth lever.

What you bring?
• Ten or more years in product management, with four or more leading product teams. Hands-on experience in GPU computing, AI or ML orchestration or HPC is ideal, and strong candidates from adjacent large-scale cloud or general-purpose cloud infrastructure, with the ability to ramp fast, will be considered.

• Fluency across GPU infrastructure on NVIDIA and AMD, container and workload orchestration such as Kubernetes, Slurm and Ray, VPC and network topologies, object storage and dedicated inference pipelines.
• Working command of multi-tenancy and tenant isolation, observability and cost attribution, sovereign deployment patterns such as air-gapped clusters and customer-managed keys, and inference economics measured as cost per token and P99 latency.
• Commercial fluency, so that you connect product decisions to gross margin, resource efficiency and customer return.

How you work?

• You have a default to action and high standards, and you pair them with the judgment to say no and to sequence well.
• You are a low-ego and articulate communicator who earns credibility quickly with engineers, enterprise CTOs and executive leadership.
• You are comfortable building in a category that is still being created.

Your first 90 days

• Establish a working rhythm with engineering, operations and go-to-market that delivers predictably.

Success in the first 6 to 12 months

• Movement on the economics you own, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin and tenant density.
• Time to production for offtake customers and time to value in onboarding, both trending down.
• Expansion on named enterprise and offtake accounts.
• A high-functioning product team with clear ownership and a rising bar.
